title: Agenomic Coding Session Event (agenomic.coding.event/v1)
description: Envelope of one event observed in a supervised coding-agent session (Claude Code, Codex). RFC 0012. Events are delivered at least once and deduplicated on (coding_session_id, event_id) and on (coding_session_id, source, producer_epoch, producer_seq). Ordering is defined per source by (producer_epoch, producer_seq); there is no global producer order. A request, a decision, an observed start and an observed result are distinct facts carried by distinct events: an allow decision is not proof of execution. Content fields inside payload (text, command, diff, output) appear only when the session's capture settings allow them and are redacted by the producer before export.

event_id.description: ULID (Crockford base32, 26 characters). Re-delivering the same event_id is a no-op.

source.description: Component that produced the event. runtime: the coding agent itself (native hook or SDK message); adapter: the connector adapter translating native signals; gateway: the Agenomic gateway (decisions, approvals); supervisor: the connector process supervisor (spawn, exit, heartbeat loss); filesystem: workspace observation (file and diff snapshots).

trust.description: native: reported by the runtime's own documented interface; derived: computed by the adapter from native signals; observed: inferred from outside the runtime (process table, filesystem, git). Consumers MUST NOT treat derived or observed facts as native.

producer_epoch.description: Identifier of one producer lifetime (typically the connector boot ULID). producer_seq restarts at 0 when the epoch changes.

producer_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number of this event within (source, producer_epoch).

action_id.description: Links the event to an Agenomic coding action (coding-action.schema.json).

payload.description: Type-specific, redacted payload. Metadata only unless content capture was explicitly enabled for the session. Never carries hidden model reasoning.
